accessDenied.title: No driver access
accessDenied.reason: Your role cannot review riders at {branch}.

header.title: Drivers
header.applied: {count, plural, one {# driver has applied to this branch} other {# drivers have applied to this branch}}

loadError.title: Could not load driver applications
loadError.body: Something went wrong while reading this branch’s applications. Refresh the page to try again.

empty.title: No driver applications yet
empty.body: Riders apply from the FavorGO app. They can only apply after uploading all three KYC documents (licence, vehicle registration and a selfie), so a rider who has signed up but not finished uploading will not appear here yet.

appCard.title: Get the FavorGO app
appCard.teamIntro: Riders deliver with FavorGO. Have them scan this code to install it, then apply to {branch} from the Restaurants list in the app.
appCard.teamIntroNoBranch: Riders deliver with FavorGO. Have them scan this code to install it, then apply to this branch from the Restaurants list in the app.
appCard.selfIntro: Scan this code with your phone’s camera to open FavorGO.

steps.scan: Scan the code with the phone’s camera.
steps.open: Open the link, then sign in or create a rider account.
steps.install: Add it to the home screen: Install app on Android, or Share › Add to Home Screen on iPhone.

appCard.inAppHint: Opened inside LINE or Facebook? Choose Open in browser first — apps can’t be installed from there.
appCard.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — select the link above and copy it yourself.
appCard.pngHint: The PNG is {size}×{size} px — sharp enough to print.

card.approvedNeedsDocuments: Approved, but their documents still need reviewing — use Review documents.
card.replacedAfterVerify: They replaced a document {received}, after it was verified on {verified} — look again.
card.replacedAfterDecision: They replaced a document {received}, after your decision on {reviewed}.

approve.rejectReasonPlaceholder: Shown to the rider in their app
approve.notSaved: That didn’t save — you may not have permission to review drivers.
approve.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the decision. Try again.

review.title: Document review
review.sharedWarning: Verifying or rejecting documents here applies to every restaurant this rider works with, not just {branch}. The decision that is yours alone is Approve / Suspend on their application.
review.replacedAfterVerify: A document was replaced {replaced}, after the documents were verified on {verified}. What you are looking at below is the new file.
review.replacedAfterDecision: A document was replaced {replaced}, after your decision on {decided}. What you are looking at below is the new file.
review.listError: Could not read the rider’s documents. Close this and try again.
review.forbidden: You do not have permission to review driver documents. Only an owner or manager can.
review.sharedForbidden: This rider also works with a branch you do not manage, so a platform admin or the owner of every such branch has to decide.
review.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the document review. Try again.
review.rejectHint: Rejecting tells the rider a document needs changing, but not which one. To say why, reject their application with a reason — that text is shown in their app.
